description: Lets secuveri send its customer's verification and dashboard emails from the customer's own domain: the three Amazon SES Easy DKIM CNAME records for the domain identity secuveri registers, and a TXT record that proves the customer requested it.
variableDescription: %dkimSelector1%, %dkimSelector2%, %dkimSelector3%: the Easy DKIM tokens Amazon SES issues for the domain (32 lowercase letters and digits each). %token%: per-domain ownership token issued by secuveri (32 lowercase hex characters). The DKIM target zone is fixed.
